short: One term of large industrial legislation, high inflation, and a late withdrawal.
full:
Biden was 78 at his inauguration, the oldest person to take the office, arriving after thirty-six years in the Senate and eight as vice president. His first two years produced a $1.9 trillion pandemic relief act, a $1.2 trillion infrastructure law, the CHIPS and Science Act subsidising semiconductor manufacture, and the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, the largest American climate spending to that date.

The withdrawal from Afghanistan in August 2021 ended twenty years of war in disorder, with thirteen American service members killed at Kabul airport. He organised Western military and financial support for Ukraine after the Russian invasion of February 2022. Inflation peaked above 9 per cent in mid-2022 and dominated public assessments of his record. After a poor debate performance he abandoned his re-election campaign in July 2024, the first sitting president to withdraw since Johnson in 1968.
